name: tenders-hermes
description: Agent harness over the tenders-search-automation production pipeline
comment: Only tsx is a dependency, and only so the container can execute the
production repo's TypeScript adapters directly. cheerio and playwright are
resolved from /repo/node_modules so the versions always match production —
pinning our own copies here would let this harness silently diagnose a
different Playwright than the one that actually runs the scrape.
It lives here rather than being used from /repo because the repo's
node_modules is installed on whatever host developed it (win32 esbuild on
this machine), and the container is Linux. A local toolchain makes the
harness run identically on Windows, on a VPS, and in CI.

scripts.check: node --check harness/db.mjs && node --check harness/digest.mjs && node --check harness/classify.mjs && node --check harness/notify.mjs && node --check harness/probe-all.mjs && node --check harness/compare-origins.mjs && node --check harness/lib/source.mjs && node --check harness/lib/supabase.mjs && node --check harness/lib/probe-core.mjs && node --check eval/score.mjs && node --check eval/build-set.mjs && node --check eval/make-holdout.mjs
